name: walk-photoreal-desktop-metal-18.5_21
description: REVIEW area 1 walk-mode photoreal matrix. Arm desktop-metal, hours 18.5, 21, lights off+on, 16 poses across 8 rooms, realistic tier, walk mode.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: enter-walk
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setCameraMode('firstPerson')

steps.name: hide-hud
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-move'); s.dismissChecklist?.() })()

steps.name: probe-boot
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const gl = window.__three.gl; const c = gl.getContext(); const d = c.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info'); console.log('[probe] arm desktop-metal tier=' + s.qualityTier + ' device=' + s.deviceClass + ' dpr=' + gl.getPixelRatio() + ' renderer=' + (d ? c.getParameter(d.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) : 'n/a')) })()
